lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular blobs organized into vertical columns, with approximately five spots per column in the region immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity that align with the vertical columns of blobs, forming a matrix of grid-like anchor nodes across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible along the upper and middle flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradient indicating structural ridges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse and low-contrast distribution of approximately 5-8 high-luminance circular clusters within the boundary of the visible dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin shows a high density of smaller, high-intensity white spots concentrated along its leading edge and distributed across its dorsal surface.
